messages:
sam: Quick sync  In the new rollout flow we don't surface an immediate $ estimate that accounts for variant-specific cache behavior. someone ran a small canary and tenant spend jumped. we need a 'what-if' in the modal.

lee: Agreed. simplest: show $/hr delta and a tiny confidence tag. backend can simulate using 7d medians for tokens and cache hit rates. keep UX minimal.

zoe: Also add a "safety budget" toggle: alert at +30% over baseline for 10m, pause at +150% for 3m. Ops should be able to override per-tenant.

sam: For telemetry, here's a quick sketch of the server sim logic:

```
for each variant v:
  median_tokens = sample_median(route, v, window=7d)
  hit_rate = sample_hit_rate(route, v, window=7d)
  effective_tokens = median_tokens * (1 - hit_rate)
  cost = effective_tokens * price_per_token(v)
proj_delta = sum(new_prob[v]*cost) - sum(baseline_prob[v]*cost)
```

lee: We should surface also a "cache-sensitivity" row that shows worst-case (hit_rate=0) and best-case (hit_rate=prev_global). good for PMs.

zoe: UX note: one-line $/hr + confidence + small chevron to expand to breakdown (per-variant tokens, hit rate, price). include an "assumptions" link that lists window and price-table version.

infra-bot: [metric] pushed route.variant.cache_hit_rate at 2026-06-12T08:44Z.

sam: Action items: (1) add proj $/hr and confidence to rollout modal, (2) expose cache-sensitivity toggle (worst/baseline), (3) soft-budget defaults + per-tenant override, (4) add assumptions panel. I'll file a ticket.

lee: I'll implement the telemetry endpoint and keep sampling at 1% to avoid explosion.

zoe: I'll mock the compact UI and tooltips. will post Figma link.

sam: thanks. ticket INF-8920 created. tagging @lee @zoe for follow-ups.
